item.title: European nations maintain World Cup boycott, leaving FIFA's Infantino uncertain
item.description: The ongoing World Cup boycott by European countries is a major challenge for FIFA, keeping President Gianni Infantino under significant pressure to step down.

item.title: A wildlife park in central Sri Lanka serves as an elephant sanctuary
item.description: Amid rising human-elephant conflict due to agricultural expansion, Hurulu Eco Park provides a safe haven for elephants in central Sri Lanka.

item.title: New flu vaccine for older adults expected soon
item.description: The first mRNA-based flu shot approved by the FDA will be available for the upcoming flu season. Moderna, the manufacturer, is preparing for distribution.

item.title: Park Service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be relocated?
item.description: The National Park Service reports that the proposed arch in Memorial Circle would impact numerous nearby landmarks. There has been little discussion...
